id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

harness_id.description: A harness identifier: `hrn_` followed by a ULID.

autonomy.description: 0 observe, 1 ask first, 2 ask when it matters, 3 autonomous and report back. Presets that expand to rules.

match.description: A glob over action kinds, for example `payment.*`.

when.description: Extra conditions on the action's flags, and for a command, how its parts start.

items.description: A risk class the policy engine can match a rule against.

starts_with.description: For an action that carries a command (ADR 0239): the words a part of it starts with. A command goes ahead on such rules only when every part starts with one that allows it.

decision.description: What to do when the rule matches.

approvers.description: Who may answer, when the decision is `ask`.

items.description: `owner`, `any`, `lead`, `role:<name>`, or a specific person id; a lead harness's id once resolved.

reason.description: Shown to the harness, and recorded in the audit log.

off.description: Turned off by a person (ADR 0195): kept in the list to turn back on, and skipped by the policy engine until then.

made_by.description: Who made it by answering an ask with Always (ADR 0195). Filled in by Chips.

made_at.description: When a person's answer made it (ADR 0195): Always, or This session. Filled in by Chips. A rule a person's answer made never allows an action that matters.

items.description: A rule the policy engine evaluates.

rules.description: Evaluated in order; the workspace cap always wins.

policy.description: A harness's autonomy level and the rules that fill in the details.

workspace_max_autonomy.description: The workspace cap. It always wins.

budget_usd.description: The harness's spending ceiling, in US dollars. Absent leaves it as it was; the harness's spend is what `usage` has added up.

changed_by.description: Who changed it, or `system` for an earned promotion. Filled in by Chips from the credential that sent it.

description: The autonomy level or the rules changed. Takes effect on the next action, not retroactively.
title: PolicyUpdated
